title: Activation Lane: customer network readiness & staged upgrade playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a repeatable 'activation lane' playbook to triage Private/VPC/on-prem customer requests that require networking changes, OS/agent upgrades, or air-gapped constraints. The playbook will standardize intake scoring, define minimum network probes, outline staged upgrade steps with rollback criteria, and provide communication templates for engineering, PM, and customer success. Goal: reduce mean time from request to readiness by 40% and reduce ad-hoc engineering investigations.
acceptance_criteria: A single-page playbook hosted in Confluence with step-by-step triage flow
Automated preflight probe checklist (bash + curl/sshtunnel samples) that customers can run and upload results
Priority scoring rubric documented and applied to new intake for 30-day pilot
Two sample runbooks for common scenarios: VPC peering + NAT restrictions, and air-gapped environment with restricted egress
Sign-off from Security and Infra teams on rollout and gating
SLA for initial triage response published for Enterprise requests
triage_flow_steps: 1) Intake capture: route request to 'activation-lane' intake form with required network artifacts (topology diagram, firewall egress rules, OC IDs)
2) Automated preflight: customer runs provided probe script; results uploaded to ticket; script performs DNS resolution, outbound port checks, and KV cache connectivity simulation
3) Triage scoring: apply rubric (customer risk, data sensitivity, upgrade footprint, SLA tier) to assign priority and runway
4) Engagement handoff: assign eng lead, security reviewer, and CSM; schedule readiness sync within 3 business days for P0/P1
5) Staged upgrade plan: define a canary host set, backout procedure, and KPIs (latency, error-rate, token throughput) to monitor during the rollout
6) Onsite/on-prem checklist: define required local firewall/NAT entries, expected package downloads (or offline bundle), and HSM/KMS connectivity options
7) Fallback and rollback: automated rollback triggers for >5% error-rate or latency spikes >2x baseline for 10m
8) Closure and retro: collect post-mortem, update playbook artifacts, and surface learnings to product+engineering weekly
probe_examples_and_commands: KV/caching probe: request a small pre-warmed prefix and verify TTL behaviour using our probe endpoint
Airgap bundle test: checksum verification of offline bundle and local installation dry-run script
communication_templates: Initial triage DM to customer: short checklist + link to probe script and expected artifacts
Internal incident handoff: template with priority, impacted customers, runbook link, and pager contacts
Upgrade window notice: template for scheduling canary and full rollout with rollback window and KPIs
Post-upgrade status: success/failure template with telemetry snapshot and next steps
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: customers provide incomplete network topology; Mitigation: mandatory intake artifacts enforced by form
Risk: probe scripts fail in very locked-down airgapped environments; Mitigation: provide offline bundle + manual runbook and support lane
Risk: rollout causes transient perf regressions; Mitigation: canary host set, automated KPIs, and fast rollback
Risk: regulatory constraints prevent remote troubleshooting; Mitigation: local agent installation checklist and approved customer-contact SOP
timeline_and_milestones: Week 1: Draft playbook and probe scripts; internal review with Infra and Security
Week 2: Build intake form + priority scoring automation; pilot with two existing enterprise customers
Week 3: Iterate on feedback, finalize communication templates, and publish Confluence playbook
Week 4: Launch 30-day pilot and collect metrics (time-to-ready, number of escalations)
